subject: Ciências da Natureza e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Analisar os ciclos biogeoquímicos e interpretar os efeitos de fenômenos naturais e da interferência humana sobre esses ciclos, para promover ações individuais e/ ou coletivas que minimizem consequências nocivas à vida.

components.description_pt: Descrever etapas de principais ciclos biogeoquímicos (carbono, nitrogênio, água, etc.)
components.description_en: Describe the stages of major biogeochemical cycles (carbon, nitrogen, water, etc.)
components.cc_component_description: Describe how water cycles between the atmosphere, hydrosphere, geosphere, and biosphere

components.description_pt: Interpretar efeitos de fenômenos naturais em ciclos biogeoquímicos
components.description_en: Interpret the effects of natural phenomena on biogeochemical cycles
components.cc_component_description: Compare the relative effects of different causes on changes within a system

components.description_pt: Analisar consequências de interferência humana em ciclos biogeoquímicos
components.description_en: Analyze the consequences of human interference on biogeochemical cycles
components.cc_component_description: Analyze feedback loops within a computational model to predict consequences of ongoing human activity on Earth systems

components.description_pt: Propor ações individuais ou coletivas para minimizar impactos prejudiciais em ciclos biogeoquímicos
components.description_en: Propose individual or collective actions to minimize harmful impacts on biogeochemical cycles
components.cc_component_description: Apply scientific principles to propose strategies that minimize a specific human impact on the environment

cc_matches.description: Develop a model to describe the cycling of water through Earth's systems driven by energy from the sun and the force of gravity.
Changes in systems may have various causes that may not have equal effects.
Use a computational representation to illustrate the relationships among Earth systems and how those relationships are being modified due to human activity.
Apply scientific principles to design a method for monitoring and minimizing a human impact on the environment.
